sgw.seoDescription: Which vehicle brands have a Security Gateway (SGW) from which model year, and whether a bypass cable or an SGW license is required – the complete GlobeGuard overview.
sgw.title: SGW Compatibility
sgw.subtitle: Newer vehicles protect their diagnostic interface with a Security Gateway (SGW). Without unlocking it, only read access is possible – no actuator tests, coding or service resets. This overview shows which brands are affected from which model year and what you need.
sgw.tableCaption: Brand groups with a Security Gateway
sgw.note: All other brand groups currently require no SGW unlocking. PRO devices support vehicles from model year {proFromYear}, BASIC from {basicFromYear}.
sgw.licensesText: Licenses for Fiat/Stellantis, Mercedes-Benz, the VW Group and Hyundai/Kia – flexible from 1 day. You can purchase a license at any time whenever you need it.
sgw.cablesText: Physical adapters for the Fiat Group (2018–2020) and the Iveco Daily (from 2018).
